mappings_region.name: mappings_region
mappings_region.value: "mappings"."region" is null or char_length("mappings"."region") between 1 and 200

suppliers_default_region.name: suppliers_default_region
suppliers_default_region.value: "suppliers"."default_region" is null or char_length("suppliers"."default_region") between 1 and 200

suppliers_pause_reason.name: suppliers_pause_reason
suppliers_pause_reason.value: ("suppliers"."enabled" and "suppliers"."paused_reason" is null) or (not "suppliers"."enabled" and "suppliers"."paused_reason" is not null and "suppliers"."paused_reason" in ('owner', 'session'))
